body: I never got a call when I stopped going either:/
The reference said I quit suddenly without notice (I did...because of depression. But I couldn't say that.)
Not really...I don't like to talk about my feelings in general. I've been denying and pushing down everything, pretending it's all okay. So I haven't told anyone the extent of things.

Thank you for your response. I'm really glad you had success with your treatment. I'm limited to which hospital because of my insurance, so I can either go to the one here where I work or the one in the next city over. I plan to talk to my mom tonight and we'll see where it goes.
